sn47.39:1.3: katamā ca bhikkhave, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvanā:
sn47.39:1.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.39:1.7: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.39:1.8: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvanāti.
